services.name: Book A Tandem with Us
services.desc: Established in and family owned since 1984, we are proud to be Hawaii’s longest running skydiving operation. We are honored and privileged to operate out of the historic Kawaihapai Airfield (HDH) along the breathtaking North Shore of Oahu, sharing a unique and memorable way to experience the beauty of the North Shore

includes: Photos and HD video included in 20,000 ft jump price
gap: Exact duration of the 20,000 ft jump not stated
blurb: Guests experience tandem skydiving with USPA licensed instructors from 14,000 or 20,000 feet. The jump includes a safety briefing, free-fall at 120 mph, and a canopy descent with scenic views. Operations run from 7:00am to 3:00pm with shuttle service available.
extraNote: Reservations preferred but walk-ins accepted on most days, first come first serve · Wait times vary from 2-6 hours due to weather, air traffic, and other factors · Weather delays possible; operations resume when safe or reschedule offered · Kawaihapai Airfield (HDH) on Oahu’s North Shore
